title: Relight the Refectory
summary: Twenty-seven place settings, still warm, still steaming, in a hall that stopped mid-feast. Three chairs are pushed back. The ovens hold bread that has been halfway risen since before the Sundering.

objectives.text: Recover the kitchen-master's undelivered supply order

title: Ring the Half-Rung Bell
summary: The commencement bell has been holding one note since the Long Second began. Its clapper rests a finger's width from the rim. It needs its true pitch back before it can finish the sound it started.

objectives.text: Find the ring the half-rung bell

title: Hold the Mending
summary: A healer's hands, a student's wound, and one spell that has rewritten itself a thousand times to keep running. It is the only magic still working on the frozen campus and it is very nearly finished.

objectives.text: Shore the weave with fresh reagents

title: The Counter-Reading
summary: Inside the Long Second the sky does not move, which means for the first time in history somebody could read it slowly. The lens is aimed. What is missing is what the sky looked like before.

objectives.text: Recover the night-ledgers from the week of the Sundering

title: Raise the Threshold Wards
summary: The gatehouse wards were broken from the inside, with surgical knowledge of where every seal anchored. The arch has been replaying that half-second ever since. Rebuilding it means learning what the breaker learned.

objectives.text: Find the raise the threshold wards
Recover the warding primer the breaker studied from
Raise new wards from the primer

title: Catalogue the Uncatalogued Wing
summary: Ten thousand books hang in the air mid-reshelving, in a wing whose index was being rewritten. Nothing in this room is anywhere twice. One brushed sleeve ages a text to dust.

objectives.text: Read the three titles Kassian requested

title: The Academy Wakes
summary: Six places on the campus stopped mid-motion when the Sundering took it. None of them can be finished from inside the Long Second alone. Every one needs something carried in from the world outside. Restore all six.
